# Flowstate

> Flowstate is an Auckland company that builds AI automation for New Zealand trade businesses.

Flowstate (flowstate.net.nz) builds AI helpers on the software a trade business already uses: Fergus, Simpro, ServiceM8, AroFlo, Tradify and Xero. The AI drafts quotes, invoices, follow-ups and review requests, as drafts for the owner to approve. It starts with a free 30-minute call, then a custom implementation plan if it's a fit, with scope and rate agreed before any build starts. The foundation takes 2 to 3 days, and helpers are built one at a time on top. Flowstate has delivered for 10+ clients across different trades, and is backed by an electrical company that has been automating its own business for six years.
